sanskrit: adarśi gātuvittamo yasmin vratāny ādadhuḥ | upo ṣu jātam āryasya vardhanaṃ somaṃ gacchantu no giraḥ ||
english: He has been seen — the best knower of the way — in whom vows have been placed. Let our songs go to Soma, the promoter of the noble one's growth, the newborn.

sanskrit: pra daivodāso agnir devām̐ acchā na majmanā | anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||
english: Agni, the god-given, shines forth toward the gods by his greatness. He turned back following his mother Earth, and stood upon the ridge of heaven.

sanskrit: yasmād rejanti kṛṣṭayaś carkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ | sahasrasā medhasātāv iva tman- -āgniṃ dhībhir duvasyata ||
english: From whom peoples tremble as he performs his notable deeds — tend Agni with devotions in your own person, as if winning a thousand prizes at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
english: Swell, O Soma; may your virile force come together to you from all sides. Be present at the gathering of nourishment.

sanskrit: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhir aṃśubhiḥ | bhavā naḥ sumnayuḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
english: Swell, O most exhilarating Soma, with all your shoots. Be our benevolent friend for our growth.

sanskrit: saṃ te payāṃsi sam u yantu vajāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsy uttamāni dhiṣva ||
english: May your milky streams come together, may your nourishments come together, may your virile powers come together, O overcomer of enemies. As you swell, O Soma, for immortality, establish the highest glories in heaven.

sanskrit: vidma tvā vayaṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ ye tvā na viduḥ | teṣāṃ cakṣuṣā śrotreṇa prāṇena prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanenā pyāyasva | eṣā ta oṣadhīs tayā tvam ā pyāyasva ||
english: We know you, O Soma, as king; those who do not know you — swell through their eyes, through their hearing, their breath, their offspring, their cattle, their houses, their wealth. These are your plants; through them do you swell.

sanskrit: āpīno asmān āpyāyac cakṣuṣā śrotreṇa prāṇena prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena ||
english: May the swollen one cause us to swell with eye, with hearing, with breath, with offspring, with cattle, with house, with wealth.

sanskrit: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ | indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat satyaṃ cittamohanam ||
english: What King Varuṇa knows, what the god Bṛhaspati knows, what Indra the slayer of Vṛtra knows — that truth is the bewilderer of minds.

sanskrit: śarveṇa nīlaśikhaṇḍena bhavena marutāṃ pitrā | virūpākṣeṇa babhruṇā vācaṃ vadiṣyato hatāḥ ||
english: By Śarva of the blue topknot, by Bhava, father of the Maruts, by Virūpākṣa the tawny one — struck down are those who are about to speak a word.

sanskrit: etad yad anyatra jigāṃsatha yad anyatra vivīṣatha | tad vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tad vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
english: This that you wish to go elsewhere, that you desire to move elsewhere — I have bewildered your mind in that, I have caused your mind to be lost in that.

sanskrit: asti vai pathāṃ niṣkuṭaṃ nadīnāṃ ca niraṅkaśam | tena vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tena vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
english: There is indeed a hidden nook of paths and an uncontrolled flow of rivers. By that I have bewildered your mind, by that I have caused your mind to be lost.

sanskrit: yāni vaḥ sapta cetāṃsy aṣṭau yāni manāṃsi ca | tad vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tad vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
english: Your seven perceptions and your eight minds — I have bewildered your mind in that, I have caused your mind to be lost in that.

sanskrit: indreṇa medinā yuj- -āgninā jātavedasā | tena vaś cittam amūmuhaṃ tena vaś cittam anīnaśam ||
english: Allied with Indra the munificent, with Agni who knows all beings — by that I have bewildered your mind, by that I have caused your mind to be lost.

sanskrit: pratīcīnāṃ vo abhy adhām aśvam ivāśvābhidhānyā | kṛṇve vo māmake vaśe pador upānahau yathā ||
english: I have turned you backward, as a hobble holds a horse. I make you subject to my will, as sandals are subject to the feet.

sanskrit: devānāṃ saṃsad asi devānāṃ yātur asi | yayā tanvā brahma jinvasi tayā mā jinva ||
english: You are the assembly of the gods, you are the going of the gods. With that body by which you quicken sacred power, with that do quicken me.

sanskrit: roce mā prakāśe mā kaṇvā vidan mā gamaya | anu mā budhyantām ||
english: Do not make me shine, do not make me visible; let not the Kaṇvas find me, do not lead me there. Let them remain unaware of me.

sanskrit: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedur indraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ | apa dhvāntam ūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣur mumugdhy asmān nidhayeva baddhān ||
english: The birds of good wing, the Priyamedha seers, imploring, have sat near Indra. Roll away the darkness, fill up our vision, release us who are bound as if in a dungeon.

sanskrit: apsu jātasya mahatas pary aśmanaḥ | svayaṃjātasya śociṣo 'dbhiḥ parvata nāśaya ||
english: Of the great one born in the waters, born from around the rock — O mountain, destroy with the waters the flame of the self-born one.

sanskrit: uttodinīṃ śimidvatī durgayonir vyadvarām | mṛgām̐ anu pra pātaya marīcīr anu nāśaya ||
english: The one who swells upward, the Śimidvatī, of difficult origin, the one with open door — make the animals fall after her, destroy them along with the mirage-like rays.

sanskrit: aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā parṇe te vasatiṣ kṛtā | asṛk patatriṇām asi jahi vāmūn pra bādhama ||
english: Fallen from the mouth of a horse, your dwelling is made on a leaf. You are the blood of birds — smite the crooked ones, drive them forth.

sanskrit: asṛkto adhi jāto 'si parṇe te sadanaṃ kṛtam | āṇḍaṃ patatriṇām asi jahi vāmūn pra bādhama ||
english: Born from what is not blood, your seat is made on a leaf. You are the egg of birds — smite the crooked ones, drive them forth.

sanskrit: yathā gardabho vivartanād vidhūya vipalāyate | evāsau palāyatām amuṣmād adhy āyataḥ ||
english: As a donkey, shaking itself from rolling in the dust, runs away — just so let that one run away from here, who has come upon this.

sanskrit: sanir asi sanitāsi saneyam ||
english: You are acquisition; you will acquire; may I acquire.

sanskrit: kṛtir asi kartāsi kriyāsam ||
english: You are action; you will act; may I act.

sanskrit: vittir asi vettāsi videyam ||
english: You are knowledge; you will know; may I know.

sanskrit: bhūtir asi bhūtāsi bhūyāsam ||
english: You are prosperity; you will prosper; may I prosper.

sanskrit: bhūr asi subhūr asi subhūr nāmāsi ||
english: You are bhūr; you are subhūr; Subhūr is your name.

sanskrit: prajāpater madhyamaḥ śreṣṭho raśmir asi ||
english: You are the middle and best ray of Prajāpati.

sanskrit: bhūtaye tvā vittaye tvā paśūnāṃ tvā vittaya ā dadhāmi ||
english: For prosperity I place you, for wealth I place you, for the acquisition of cattle I place you.

sanskrit: agnir vahnir vahnir agniḥ ||
english: Agni is the carrier; the carrier is Agni.

sanskrit: indra āroddhā prajāpatiḥ pradātā ||
english: Indra is the obstructor; Prajāpati is the giver.

sanskrit: bṛhaspates tvā mukhena yācāmi sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣe adabdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣe ||
english: With the mouth of Bṛhaspati I implore you; with the eye of the Sun I look toward you; with the undeceived eye I look upon you.

sanskrit: ayuto 'ham ayuto ma ātmā ayutaṃ me cakṣur ayutaṃ me śrotram ayuto me prāṇo ayuto me 'pāno ayuto 'haṃ sarvaḥ ||
english: I am unloosed; my self is unloosed; my eye is unloosed; my hearing is unloosed; my in-breath is unloosed; my out-breath is unloosed; I am wholly unloosed.

sanskrit: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūta ā rabhe ||
english: At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, urged by the arms of the Aśvins, by the hands of Pūṣan, I take hold.

sanskrit: agneṣ ṭvāsyena prāśnāmi bṛhaspater mukhena ||
english: With the mouth of Agni I eat you; with the mouth of Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit: indrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmi varuṇasyodare ||
english: I place you in the belly of Indra, in the stomach of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: yo agnir nṛmaṇā nāma brāhmaṇeṣu praviṣṭaḥ ||
english: The fire named Nṛmaṇas — the man-minded one — who has entered into the brahmin priests.

sanskrit: tasminn etat suhutam astu prāśitaṃ tan mā mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman ||
english: May this be well-offered in him; may that which is eaten not harm me in the highest heaven.
